description: One-time player-only visual worker evaluation. Reviewer must approve source patches before integration; no enemies, environment or global lighting changes.

tasks.goal: Player-only: upgrade Bellwarden sword wind-up, active sweep, followthrough and smooth motion signals, and preserve green hit/contact collision. Modify only CombatMotion.java or CharacterRig.java. Do not modify enemies, world, global lighting, or control semantics.

Player Bellwarden only: improve silhouette, armor layering, detail anatomy, helmet/visor and sword hand placement while retaining deterministic finite normal geometry and efficient LOD. Modify only Bellwarden-related portions in CinematicArtKit.java or DetailArtKit.java.

Player Bellwarden metal vs cloth vs leather material readability with mobile efficient micro normal and roughness treatment; preserve ES2 and deterministic atlas existing tests. Modify only MaterialTextures.java or SurfaceAtlas.java.
